div.div: Guard admits each call, enforces the call kind’s budget (sniff 5 s, import 120 s, transform 250 ms per record, hook 5 s …) and turns panics into errors attributed to the plugin. After QUARANTINE_AFTER = 3 panics or overruns the plugin is quarantined until Health::reset. Remote calls get 0.9 × budget; a crashed host is restarted lazily (at most 3 crashes in 10 min).
